correctness.rationale: A fully quantified proof handles q=p^m in all characteristics. Projective sharply-three-transitive factorial moments independently derive every idempotent marginal; monomiality establishes exhaustiveness of four automorphism types; cubic/swap strata and quadratic-character/absolute-trace calculations supply disjoint joint counts. Independent direct finite-field program enumerates all invertible 2x2 matrices and checks every monomial automorphism and rational idempotent over q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11,13, including extensions; no finite test substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Random-algebra symmetry and nonzero idempotents are separately motivated by Question 22 of arXiv:2610.22248. The complete correlation distinguishes fields by cubic residue, quadratic-character, and absolute-trace mechanisms and supplies sharp structural exclusions (C3 only with zero, S3 only with three, C2 never with zero/two) for every finite field. This is not a re-expression of the two marginal laws.
